ValidationRule.description: Booked Date should be same as Stage 5 Entered date CloseDate formerly First Bill Date, Booked Date is now First Bill Date. #20656- Added bypass logic
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(CloseDate), ISPICKVAL(StageName, '5 - Signed/PO in'), CloseDate != IM_Stage_5_Entered_Date__c, $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> 'IM_Custom Sys Admin', NOT( $Permission.Edit_Close_Date_in_Late_Stage_Opp ), NOT($Permission.VR_Bypass_Permission) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The Close Date cannot be different than Stage 5 Entered Date. Need help? Contact your Sales Operations Business Partner.
